components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The shared primary action variant, including hover, keyboard focus, press, disabled, and touch states.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; font-family: "Inter", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, opacity 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease, transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-button:disabled { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; } .ds-button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.98); box-shadow: none; transition-duration: 80ms; }.ds-button { background: var(--primary-button, #aa386a); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px var(--control-shadow, rgb(92 35 64 / 0.12)); }.ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--primary-button-hover, #902a57); color: #fff; }@media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) { .ds-button:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 3px 8px var(--control-shadow, rgb(92 35 64 / 0.12)); } .ds-button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: scale(0.98); box-shadow: none; } }.ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary, #aa386a) 70%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }@media (max-width: 1023px), (pointer: coarse) { .ds-control { min-height: 44px; } }@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-control { transform: none !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; } }

narrative.overview:
The Sakura Library is warm and precise: a compact, task-focused interface with gentle expression. Sakura Rose accents and Blush Paper surfaces surround Plum Ink text. The light theme feels like a softly tinted catalogue; the dark theme carries the same identity through moonlit plum surfaces and pale pink highlights.

Controls are softly rounded, precise, and quietly tactile. Tonal layers organize dense work, subtle structural shadows separate surfaces, and a small hover lift gives eligible controls feedback. Cover artwork supplies the strongest imagery; the surrounding interface keeps titles, metadata, states, and actions readable.
keyCharacteristics: Sakura Rose accents, Blush Paper surfaces, and Plum Ink neutrals.
Compact Inter typography with JetBrains Mono for technical output.
Tonal layering, fine borders, and subtle structural shadows.
Softly rounded controls with brief, local interaction feedback.
Light, dark, and system themes; desktop and touch layouts.

rules.name: The Two Pink Roles Rule
rules.body: Use the semantic primary token for text, indicators, and translucent highlights; use primary-button for filled actions with white text. Preserve their separate dark-theme values.

rules.name: The Single Focus Rule
rules.body: Use the shared keyboard focus outline. Fields merge it into their border; choice groups draw it inward. Do not stack an additional ring over that indicator.

rules.name: The Local Feedback Rule
rules.body: Press feedback stays on the control. Pointer hover may lift raised buttons; reduced motion removes transforms and effectively stops animation.

dos: Do use semantic CSS variables so surfaces, text, borders, and states follow the selected theme.
Do preserve the separate primary and primary-button roles, especially in dark mode.
Do use existing button, field, card, badge, tab, and disclosure primitives for consistent states.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, labeled icon actions, and text labels alongside status colors.
Do preserve the 44px minimum touch target rules and the reduced-motion behavior.
Do allow long titles, paths, and errors to wrap; keep dense table truncation local to tables.
Do keep current and proposed metadata visibly distinct, with field selection before applying changes.
donts: Don't use the pale dark-theme primary color as a white-text filled-button background.
Don't add a second focus ring on top of the global keyboard focus outline.
Don't hard-code light-theme surface or text colors into app components.
Don't replace the installed Inter and JetBrains Mono fonts with a runtime CDN dependency.
Don't apply pointer hover lift to touch controls or retain transforms under reduced motion.
Don't treat external cover art or the screenshot sample counts as product-owned assets or measured results.
